features.formula: Official qualifying classification rank normalized to integer [1..N_entrants]
features.historical_cutoff: Strictly after Saturday Qualifying and before Sunday Race start
features.missing_value_strategy: Drivers failing to set a Q1 time are ranked at the back of Qualifying in starting grid order with no_quali_time=1
features.expected_direction: +1 (Higher numerical rank = worse qualifying position = worse expected finish / lower win & podium probability; monotonic constraint = -1 for Win/Podium)

features.formula: Official FIA final starting grid slot normalized to integer [1..N_entrants]
features.calculation_window: Current event Sunday pre-race final starting grid
features.historical_cutoff: Strictly before Sunday Race lights out (includes all post-Qualifying power unit / gearbox / sporting grid penalties)
features.missing_value_strategy: Pitlane starts placed at back of grid with pitlane_start=1
features.expected_direction: +1 (Higher numerical slot = worse starting position = worse expected finish / lower win & podium probability; monotonic constraint = -1 for Win/Podium)

features.calculation_window: Current event pre-race grid vs. qualifying classification
features.missing_value_strategy: Deterministic difference of complete integer ranks (0 missing values)
features.expected_direction: Positive values indicate net grid drop (penalty) where car pace is faster than starting slot; negative values indicate net grid promotion due to others penalties

features.formula: ((Driver_best_quali_sec - Teammate_best_quali_sec) / Session_Median_quali_sec) * 100.0; fallback to ((quali_pos - teammate_quali_pos) / Field_Size) * 5.0 when lap time unavailable
features.calculation_window: Current event Qualifying session intra-constructor comparison
features.historical_cutoff: Strictly after Qualifying and before Sunday Race start
features.missing_value_strategy: If teammate did not start (solo constructor entry), Teammate_Qualifying_Delta is left as NaN and Teammate_Missing_Flag=1 (imputed via training-fold median inside model pipeline, never silently assumed 0 in raw table)
features.expected_direction: +1 (Positive = slower than teammate in qualifying; Negative = faster than teammate)

features.formula: Exponentially recency-weighted (decay=0.60 over up to 6 prior starts) field-size normalized finishing position (scaled to 20-car reference field), shrunk toward 10.5 for <3 starts
features.calculation_window: Up to last 6 strictly prior races for the driver
features.historical_cutoff: Strictly prior completed races (Year, Round) < target race
features.missing_value_strategy: Cold-start drivers with 0 prior starts receive neutral midpoint 10.5 and is_new_driver_or_team=1
features.expected_direction: +1 (Lower value = better recent finishing form; e.g. 1.67 indicates podium/win form)

features.formula: Exponentially recency-weighted (decay=0.60 over up to 6 prior races) constructor mean finishing position (scaled to 20-car reference field), shrunk toward 11.5 for <3 races
features.calculation_window: Up to last 6 strictly prior races for the constructor
features.historical_cutoff: Strictly prior completed races (Year, Round) < target race
features.missing_value_strategy: New constructors with 0 prior races receive 11.5 and is_new_driver_or_team=1

features.formula: Empirical-Bayes smoothed (prior m=1.0 at 0.50) exponentially recency-weighted (decay=0.65) field-normalized finishing position (FinishPosition - 1)/(Field_Size - 1) at the specific circuit Location
features.calculation_window: All strictly prior appearances by the driver at that circuit Location
features.historical_cutoff: Strictly prior completed races at the circuit before target race
features.missing_value_strategy: Drivers with 0 prior circuit appearances receive neutral prior 0.50 with Driver_Track_Starts=0 and Driver_Track_Missing=1
features.expected_direction: +1 (0.0 = historical P1 dominance, 0.5 = midfield/no-history prior, 1.0 = backmarker history)

features.formula: Empirical-Bayes smoothed (prior m=2.0 races at global mean) of D_r = 1 - min(1, 2.5 * mean(|Finish - Grid| / (Field_Size - 1))) across classified non-DNF finishers at the circuit
features.calculation_window: All strictly prior races completed at the circuit Location
features.historical_cutoff: Strictly prior completed races before target race (excludes target race outcome and excludes DNF rows)
features.missing_value_strategy: First-time circuits receive historical global mean overtake difficulty (~0.58)
features.expected_direction: Higher values in [0, 1] indicate less positional movement / greater overtaking difficulty

features.formula: Empirical-Bayes smoothed (prior m=2.0 races at global DNF rate) historical in-race retirement frequency at the circuit Location
features.calculation_window: All strictly prior races completed at the circuit Location
features.historical_cutoff: Strictly prior completed races before target race
features.missing_value_strategy: First-time circuits receive historical global DNF rate (~0.14)
features.expected_direction: +1 (Higher values indicate higher historical circuit retirement risk)

features.formula: Empirical-Bayes smoothed (prior m=4 starts at global DNF rate) constructor retirement rate over last 20 car-starts (10 races), paired with Constructor_DNF_EWMA and Constructor_Attributed_Mech_Rate
features.calculation_window: Up to last 20 strictly prior car-starts for the constructor
features.historical_cutoff: Strictly prior completed races before target race
features.missing_value_strategy: New constructors receive historical global DNF prior
features.expected_direction: +1 (Higher values indicate higher constructor retirement hazard)
